description: Labelled job-match cases. Each case pairs a job description with a resume and states the verdict a competent reviewer would give, plus the skills each document should yield. The cases are chosen to break specific mechanisms, not to be easy.

cases.note: Posting and resume use different names for the same tools. A lexical matcher calls this a weak match.
cases.jd_text:
Senior Power BI Developer
Requirements:
- 4+ years building dashboards in Power BI required
- Strong DAX and SQL skills mandatory
- Tableau experience is a plus
- Excellent stakeholder communication required
cases.resume_text:
PRIYA NAIR
SUMMARY
Analytics engineer focused on reporting.
EXPERIENCE
Senior Analyst, Globex | 03/2019 - 08/2024
- Owned the enterprise reporting suite in Tableau with 200+ dashboards
- Wrote complex SQL and DAX measures for finance
- Presented insights to non-technical stakeholders weekly
SKILLS
Tableau, SQL, DAX, Power BI, Python

cases.note: Resume has the same domain vocabulary at a different altitude. A keyword matcher rewards it; the reviewer's answer is stretch, not strong.
cases.jd_text:
Civil Engineering Site Manager
Requirements:
- 8+ years managing construction site operations required
- Primavera P6 scheduling experience mandatory
- Experience with BOQ preparation and rate analysis required
- HSE and quality management responsibility essential
- MBA preferred
